title: Ensuring law and order, not snooping: Delhi Police on PIL in Delhi HC alleging surveillance of CJP protests
description: The Delhi Police on Monday denied carrying out any intrusive surveillance of the ongoing protests at Jantar Mantar led by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) [Aishe Ghosh v. Union of India & Anr].A Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia was hearing plea filed by former JNU Students' Union President and CPI(M) leader Aishe Ghosh questioning the alleged continuous and intrusive police surveillance of the protests.Solicitor General of India Tushar Mehta today told
